verdict.rationale: Drata's open-source agent reads system preferences to check screen lock, password manager, antivirus and automatic updates. Devices and Personnel API endpoints, including device upsert for custom connections, tie devices to employees. A community report confirms individual employees show up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of disk-encryption checks, documented first-party MDM integrations (e.g. Jamf/Intune), in-depth docs on per-employee workstation compliance views.
